title: Protein Expression Using E. coli Strain BL21DE3
author: Robert Hooftman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7i4hkgw

steps.title: Prepare overnight culture
steps.instruction: Prepare an overnight culture of the bacterium encoding for the target protein.

steps.title: Inoculate LB medium
steps.instruction: Inoculate an Erlenmeyer flask containing LB medium and the appropriate antibiotics with the overnight culture at a 1:100 ratio.

steps.title: Grow culture to target density
steps.instruction: Grow the bacteria at 37°C and 120 rpm until the OD600 reaches 0.6 (typically takes 2-3 hours).

steps.title: Collect pre-induction sample and cold shock
steps.instruction: Collect a 1 ml pre-induction sample and cold shock the remaining culture for 30 minutes on ice.

substeps.instruction: Store the 1 ml pre-induction sample in the fridge or freezer.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Add IPTG to the culture to a final maximum concentration of 1μM.

steps.title: Incubate culture overnight
steps.instruction: Grow the culture overnight for 18 hours at 20°C and 120 rpm.

steps.title: Determine post-induction optical density
steps.instruction: Measure the OD600 of a 10x diluted post-induction sample and calculate the 'real' optical density by multiplying the result by 10.

steps.title: Harvest samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 ml of the post-induction sample and the pre-induction sample for 10 minutes at 4700 g using a tabletop centrifuge.

steps.title: Resuspend pellets for gel loading
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellets to normalize for OD600 differences.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pre-induction pellet in 100μl of MQ.
Resuspend the post-induction pellet in 100μl x ('real' OD600 post-induction sample) / (OD600 pre-induction sample).

steps.title: Analyze protein expression
steps.instruction: Prepare the samples for loading and run both the pre-induction and post-induction samples on a protein gel.
